description: 成长内容：词族进化 + 句型迁移

family.example: He is a protector of the environment.

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: protect加-ion变成名词protection，加-ive变成形容词protective，加-or变成人protector。

family.example: Use both sides of the paper.

family.exampleCn: 我们应该重复使用塑料瓶。

family.example: That old phone is useless now.
family.exampleCn: 那部旧手机现在没用了。

family.example: He is a heavy user of the internet.
family.exampleCn: 他是一个重度互联网用户。
我买了一辆二手自行车。

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: use加-ful变成useful（有用的），加-less变成useless（无用的），加re-前缀变成reuse（再利用）。re-前缀表示「再；重新」。

family.example: Put the waste in the bin.
It's wasteful to throw away food.
We should not pour wastewater into rivers.
family.exampleCn: 我们不应该把废水排入河流。

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: waste既作动词也作名词。加-ful变成形容词wasteful（浪费的）。waste可以和很多名词组成复合词：wastepaper（废纸）、wastewater（废水）。

family.example: We should recycle paper and plastic.
family.exampleCn: 我们应该回收纸和塑料。

family.example: Recycling is good for the Earth.
family.exampleCn: 回收利用对地球有好处。

family.example: I go to school by bicycle.

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: cycle（循环）加re-前缀变成recycle（回收/再循环）。bicycle（自行车）里也有cycle，因为自行车的轮子是循环转动的。

family.example: The picture was drawn by a child.
family.exampleCn: 这幅画是一个孩子画的。

family.example: Put the pen in the drawer.

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: draw的过去式是drew，过去分词是drawn，都是不规则变化。drawing既是现在分词也是名词（绘画）。注意drawer是「抽屉」，不是「画画的人」！
electricity是名词「电」，electric是形容词「电的」，electrical是「与电有关的」，electronic是「电子的」。-ity是常见的名词后缀。

sentencePatterns.pattern: What can we do to + 动词原形?
sentencePatterns.textbookExample: What can we do to go green?
sentencePatterns.textbookExampleCn: 我们能做些什么来践行绿色生活？
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: What can we do to...? 是询问「我们能做什么来……」的常用句型。to后面接动词原形，表示目的。

transferExamples.english: What can we do to help the old man?
transferExamples.chinese: 我们能做什么来帮助那位老人？

transferExamples.english: What can we do to keep our classroom clean?
transferExamples.chinese: 我们能做什么来保持教室干净？

transferExamples.english: What can we do to learn English well?
transferExamples.chinese: 我们能做什么来学好英语？

transferExamples.english: What can we do to save animals?
transferExamples.chinese: 我们能做什么来拯救动物？

sentencePatterns.pattern: Will + 主语 + 动词原形...?
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: 一般将来时的一般疑问句：Will + 主语 + 动词原形？肯定回答：Yes, 主语 + will. 否定回答：No, 主语 + won't.

transferExamples.english: Will you come to my party?
Will they play football tomorrow?
Will she draw a picture for us?
transferExamples.chinese: 她会给我们画一幅画吗？

transferExamples.english: Will we go to the park this weekend?
transferExamples.chinese: 我们这周末会去公园吗？

sentencePatterns.pattern: 主语 + will / 'll + 动词原形
sentencePatterns.textbookExample: I'll draw the Earth and colour it green and blue.
sentencePatterns.textbookExampleCn: 我要画地球，把它涂成绿色和蓝色。
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: 一般将来时的陈述句：主语 + will + 动词原形。will可以缩写为'll（I'll, you'll, he'll, she'll, we'll, they'll）。

transferExamples.english: I'll go to the library tomorrow.
She'll sing a song at the party.
transferExamples.chinese: 她将在派对上唱一首歌。

transferExamples.english: We'll plant trees next spring.
They'll visit their grandparents this weekend.
transferExamples.chinese: 他们这周末要去看望祖父母。

sentencePatterns.pattern: Don't + 动词原形 + 其他
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: 否定祈使句的结构：Don't + 动词原形。用于表示禁止、劝告或提醒。语气比较直接强烈。

transferExamples.english: Don't run in the hallway.
Don't talk in class.
Don't eat too much candy.
Don't play with fire.

sentencePatterns.textbookExample: Turn off the tap when you brush your teeth.
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: when引导时间状语从句，表示「当……的时候」。主句是祈使句，从句用一般现在时。

transferExamples.english: Turn off the lights when you leave.
Close the door when you go out.
Wash your hands before you eat.
Look both ways before you cross the road.

growthExercises.question: 选择正确的词填空：This book is very ______. (use)
growthExercises.explanation: useful是形容词，表示「有用的」，用来描述事物的属性。

growthExercises.question: 选择正确的词填空：We should ______ old paper. (cycle)
growthExercises.explanation: recycle是动词，表示「回收利用」，should后面接动词原形。

growthExercises.question: 用所给词造句：what / can / we / do / help / the Earth
growthExercises.answer: What can we do to help the Earth?
growthExercises.explanation: What can we do to...? 我们能做什么来……？to后接动词原形表目的。

growthExercises.question: 翻译：我们应该保护地球。
growthExercises.explanation: should + 动词原形，表示应该做某事。

growthExercises.question: 翻译：离开房间时关灯。
growthExercises.answer: Turn off the lights when you leave the room.
growthExercises.explanation: 祈使句 + when引导的时间状语从句。
